requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield. CMY bottle size must support >8K yield.
requirements.Rationale: Increases ink yield per bottle, reducing frequency of replacement and supporting high-volume customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle redesign and compatibility with existing or new tank systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles pass reliability, spill-free, and integration testing; CMY bottles confirmed for >8K yield; 6K yield for Black and CMY verified.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure that the new bottles provide spill-free reliability during handling and installation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces mess and improves user experience, critical for customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills during normal bottle handling and installation in >99.5% of test cases.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F (Non-Original Accessory Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label; maintain current click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Improves product security and reliability, while ensuring compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units pass security and reliability tests, and are compatible with push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer to allow customers to replace the PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F themselves.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and lowers service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Mechanical design for easy access and replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F with no tools and minimal instruction; verified in usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends service intervals and aligns with customer expectations for durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer maintains print quality and reliability for at least 80,000 pages under normal usage.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and efficiency requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Enables sales in regulated markets and meets sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer receives EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications for the PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign the input and output trays to accommodate the increased tank size and protrusion.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and usability with the larger tank.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function without interference and support stated paper capacities with new tank design.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the printer for enhanced user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Improves usability and access to advanced features.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, UI/UX Team, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is functional, responsive, and passes usability testing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update the service station with aerosol management features to address changes due to larger tank.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink aerosol contamination and maintains internal cleanliness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels within printer remain below safety thresholds during operation and servicing.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update the carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube routing and weight distribution analysis.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force and speed tolerances in all print modes.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path components to support increased page life and durability targets.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents wear and ensures consistent performance over 80,000 pages.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components show no significant wear after 80,000 pages in testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80K Life)
requirements.Description: Design the ink maintenance box as a serviceable part to be replaced after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended printer life and serviceability.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design and service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced at service centers; replacement restores printer to operational status.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement a new make-break and fluidic interface (FI) connection for the IDS (Ink Delivery System).
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and supports new tank/bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New connection passes leak and reliability testing under all operating conditions.

requirements.Title: Increased Size, Keying, and LOI for LEBI Ink-Tank
requirements.Description: Increase the size and introduce keying and LOI (Level of Integration) features for the LEBI ink-tank.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents incorrect installation and supports higher ink volumes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tanks only accept correct bottles and support increased ink volume; confirmed in assembly and user testing.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm and air management system for the IDS.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable ink delivery and prevents air bubbles during initial setup and operation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm initializes IDS without air entrapment in >99% of test cycles.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Model
requirements.Description: Define new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion model to align with increased page yield and warranty targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality throughout the extended printer life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality meets or exceeds specified metrics for 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp PHA, Magi, Nessie Pigment Inks
requirements.Description: Reuse existing SuperAmp PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation for the Magellan program.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven technology, reduces development time and cost.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink reformulation required; confirmed compatibility with new bottles and tanks.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5, and provide molds for 1-4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing capability for new components.
requirements.Dependencies: Capital expenditure approval and line reconfiguration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines operational with new modifications and capable of meeting production targets.

requirements.Title: Support for Services and Contractual Models
requirements.Description: Support services, contractual agreements, and warranty support for NOA-F as service parts.
requirements.Rationale: Enables new business models and post-sale support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F available as service part and covered under warranty as specified.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB Manageability and Enterprise Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate SMB manageability and enterprise support features, including WJA (Web Jetadmin), HPSM (HP Smart Management), and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Meets requirements of business customers for fleet management and support.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB and Enterprise Customers, IT Admins, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer integrates with WJA, HPSM, and JAM; verified in enterprise environment tests.

requirements.Title: Support for Multiple Client and Driver Paths
requirements.Description: Provide support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility and ease of deployment across customer segments.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, IT Admins, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients/drivers install and function without errors on supported OS.

requirements.Title: Security: Gauss4.xx (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features.
requirements.Rationale: Protects against security threats and meets enterprise security standards.
requirements.Stakeholders: Enterprise Customers, IT Security, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes internal and third-party security audits for Gauss4.xx compliance.

requirements.Title: Schedule Constraints: Launch in S’27
requirements.Description: Meet time-to-market goals for S’27 with minimal investment leveraging existing platforms and technologies.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures competitive positioning and timely revenue generation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All critical path milestones achieved according to schedule.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA (Printhead Assembly) achieves a minimum life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with service interval and reliability targets for business users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes life testing for 65,000 pages without failure.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty life of 2 years for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with industry standards and customer expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published and honored for 2 years from purchase.

requirements.Title: Throughput: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Achieve print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute, with 25/19 ppm for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets performance expectations for target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers meet or exceed specified throughput in standard performance tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure the maintenance box is serviceable to support ongoing printer reliability and uptime.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and cost of service for high-usage customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by service personnel with minimal tools and time.
